_comment: Guided tour for the bare TTTR ⇄ PTO converter. One drop target, no options — the tour is about the direction rule and what is kept, which is the only thing there is to know.

steps.title: The drop decides the direction
steps.text: There is no pack/unpack switch. Drop a vendor file — .ptu, .spc, .ht3 — and it is packed into a .pto. Drop a .pto and it is unpacked back out to the vendor files it embeds. The tool reads the suffix and goes.

steps.title: Nothing is ever deleted
steps.text: Packing writes the .pto beside the vendor file and keeps the original. Unpacking writes the vendor files back and keeps the container. Either direction can be repeated or thrown away with no loss.

await.hint: Drop a vendor file (or a .pto) on the list to convert it.

steps.title: Files dropped together are one measurement
steps.text: A recording split across m000.spc, m001.spc, … is one measurement, so files dropped together are packed into one .pto, in lexical name order. Drop them as a group and the container comes out whole.

steps.title: The .set rides along, never leads
steps.text: A Becker & Hickl .set is an .spc's sidecar. Dropped alongside, it is picked up automatically with the file it belongs to; dropped alone, it is never itself packed — it is not a measurement, it is the header of one.
